task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

model.model_family: Fixed-parameter association model with bounded covariates and additive diastolic-pressure and pulse-pressure innovations

covariates.dependence: Draw female first, age conditional on female, and BMI conditional on age and female. The BMI beta innovation is independent of female and the age innovation.

bp_conditional_mean.bmi_coefficient_rule: Multiply each reported INTERSALT per-kg/m2 coefficient by projection_design.bmi_scale.
bp_conditional_mean.bmi_bridge: Assume no net change in the BMI partial coefficient when dropping urinary sodium, urinary potassium and alcohol from adjustment, replacing inverse-variance pooling of within-centre coefficients by the declared weighted target population, extending the age range, or transferring measurement methods. Impose linear conditional means with no interactions.

innovations.distribution: Independently centered and variance-standardized beta variables
innovations.dependence: The two innovations are independent of each other and of all covariates. SBP equals DBP plus pulse pressure, so SBP and DBP innovations are not independent.
innovations.combination: DBP = mean_DBP + error_DBP; pulse pressure = mean_SBP - mean_DBP + error_PP; SBP = DBP + pulse pressure.

population_transfer.selection: Model the eligible peso_lab-weighted complete-case distribution directly. Eligibility, pregnancy handling and positive laboratory weights are assumed absorbed into this law; do not simulate a national population or a separate selection mechanism.
population_transfer.equal_weight_representation: Rows are independent equal-weight draws from the completed analytical-population law.
population_transfer.treatment_and_hba1c: No treatment, hypertension or HbA1c exclusion. Unrecorded treatment and disease mixtures are absorbed into the single conditional BP law.
population_transfer.measurement: Treat generated variables as released baseline age, recorded sex, BMI and final interview BP. Assume no additional numerical measurement conversion; baseline timing and unknown final-reading aggregation remain unresolved.
population_transfer.support: Use the declared age interval, the specified conditional bounded BMI distribution and bounded BP innovations, without rejection or clipping. No original weight-height records or additional dictionary limits are available.

uncertainty.policy: One fixed-parameter completion, not a posterior predictive mixture.
uncertainty.source_standard_errors: Retained as source coefficient-estimation uncertainty only; not used as individual dispersion or transfer uncertainty.
uncertainty.parameter_sampling: None. Seeds change individual draws, not scientific parameters.
uncertainty.transfer_uncertainty: Unquantified; all transport and unidentified-distribution settings are explicit assumptions.
